include "globals.mzn";

enum HOUSECOLOR = {red, green, ivory, yellow, blue};
enum NATIONALITY = {englishman, spaniard, ukrainian, norwegian, japanese};
enum DRINK = {coffee, tea, milk, orangeJuice, water};
enum CIGARETTE = {oldGold, kools, chesterfields, luckyStrike, parliaments};
enum PET = {dog, snails, fox, horse, zebra};

int: N = 5;

array[1..N] of var HOUSECOLOR: houseColors;
array[1..N] of var NATIONALITY: nationalities;
array[1..N] of var DRINK: drinks;
array[1..N] of var CIGARETTE: cigarettes;
array[1..N] of var PET: pets;

constraint
    % Clue 1: The Englishman lives in the red house
    forall(i in 1..N)(nationalities[i] = englishman -> houseColors[i] = red) /\
    
    % Clue 2: The Spaniard owns the dog
    forall(i in 1..N)(nationalities[i] = spaniard -> pets[i] = dog) /\
    
    % Clue 3: Coffee is drunk in the green house
    forall(i in 1..N)(houseColors[i] = green -> drinks[i] = coffee) /\
    
    % Clue 4: The Ukrainian drinks tea
    forall(i in 1..N)(nationalities[i] = ukrainian -> drinks[i] = tea) /\
    
    % Clue 5: The green house is immediately to the right of the ivory house
    exists(i in 1..N-1)(houseColors[i] = ivory /\ houseColors[i+1] = green) /\
    
    % Clue 6: The Old Gold smoker owns snails
    forall(i in 1..N)(cigarettes[i] = oldGold -> pets[i] = snails) /\
    
    % Clue 7: Kools are smoked in the yellow house
    forall(i in 1..N)(houseColors[i] = yellow -> cigarettes[i] = kools) /\
    
    % Clue 8: Milk is drunk in the middle house
    drinks[3] = milk /\
    
    % Clue 9: The Norwegian lives in the first house
    nationalities[1] = norwegian /\
    
    % Clue 10: The man who smokes Chesterfields lives in the house next to the man with the fox
    exists(i in 1..N-1)(cigarettes[i] = chesterfields /\ pets[i+1] = fox \/ pets[i] = fox /\ cigarettes[i+1] = chesterfields) /\
    
    % Clue 11: Kools are smoked in the house next to the house where the horse is kept
    exists(i in 1..N-1)(cigarettes[i] = kools /\ pets[i+1] = horse \/ pets[i] = horse /\ cigarettes[i+1] = kools) /\
    
    % Clue 12: The Lucky Strike smoker drinks orange juice
    forall(i in 1..N)(cigarettes[i] = luckyStrike -> drinks[i] = orangeJuice) /\
    
    % Clue 13: The Japanese smokes Parliaments
    forall(i in 1..N)(nationalities[i] = japanese -> cigarettes[i] = parliaments) /\
    
    % Clue 14: The Norwegian lives next to the blue house
    forall(i in 1..N-1)(nationalities[i] = norwegian -> houseColors[i+1] = blue \/ houseColors[i] = blue -> nationalities[i+1] = norwegian) /\
    
    % All different constraints
    alldifferent(nationalities) /\
    alldifferent(houseColors) /\
    alldifferent(drinks) /\
    alldifferent(cigarettes) /\
    alldifferent(pets);

solve satisfy;
